hero.alt: Daymark Today screen with a labeled sample day, the next event, open tasks, and rituals.
hero.label: Sample day
hero.caption: Today

chapters.title: Plan the day.
chapters.intro: Today puts the next event first, then your tasks and rituals. Add a task or check in on a ritual without opening another page.

steps.alt: Today’s brief sheet with the next event, open tasks, rituals kept, focus totals, and Ask Daymark.
steps.title: A brief, when you want one.
steps.body: Tap Brief for what is next, what is open, the rituals kept, and today’s focus, with Ask Daymark one tap away.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Today’s brief

steps.alt: Today with an Apple Weather card for Phoenix above open tasks and the first event of the day.
steps.title: The forecast beside the plans.
steps.body: The selected city’s Apple Weather forecast appears above tasks and events for the day.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Today with weather

steps.alt: Day view with a week strip and hourly timeline for sample events.
steps.title: See the day in hours.
steps.body: Open the day to see events laid out in time, and step through the week from the strip above.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Day

steps.alt: Month view for October 2026 with days that have events marked and the 19th selected.
steps.title: Find a day in the month.
steps.body: Days with events carry a mark. Tap one to open it.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Month

steps.alt: Tasks page with open tasks grouped by day and one finished task under Done.
steps.title: Every task in one list.
steps.body: Open tasks are grouped by day. Finished ones fold away under Done.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Tasks

steps.alt: Block time sheet for a task with a start date, time, duration, and calendar action.
steps.title: Give a task its time.
steps.body: Block time for a task with a start and a length. It lands in the daybook, and on your Apple calendar once you import a writable one.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Block time

chapters.title: Keep a practice.
chapters.intro: Set a daily, weekday, or weekly rhythm, then review check-ins across the week.

steps.alt: Rituals page with four sample practices and a weekly check-in ledger.
steps.title: Check in across the week.
steps.body: Use daily, weekday, or weekly cadences. Check in from Today or from the Rituals page.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Rituals

chapters.title: Protect your attention.
chapters.intro: Give one task a protected block of time, then see where today’s focus went.

steps.alt: Focus page with a 25-minute timer, session controls, and focus history.
steps.title: One dial, one task.
steps.body: Run a Pomodoro with focus, short rest, and long rest, or pick a 25, 50, or 90 minute session.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Focus

steps.alt: Timers page with a sample birthday countdown and reusable timers.
steps.title: Timers and countdowns.
steps.body: Keep reusable timers for the things you do often, and count down to the dates ahead.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Timers

steps.alt: Seven-day focus history with today’s sessions listed below.
steps.title: See where the time went.
steps.body: Focus history keeps the last seven days and today’s sessions in one ledger.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Focus history

steps.alt: Review page with a running Focus session pinned above the tab bar.
steps.title: Focus comes with you.
steps.body: A running session stays in view while you move to another page.
steps.label: Sample week
steps.caption: Focus while reviewing

chapters.title: Review what mattered.
chapters.intro: Weekly Review gathers completed tasks, focus sessions, and ritual check-ins from the week you recorded.

steps.alt: Review page labeled sample week, showing task, focus, and ritual totals.
steps.title: A week you can see.
steps.body: Tasks done, focus minutes, and rituals kept come together beside three prompts: what mattered, what got in the way, and one change for next week.
steps.label: Sample week
steps.caption: Review

chapters.title: Keep what deserves to stay.
chapters.intro: Notes, links, and images in one place. Share from another app and it lands on the Shelf the next time you open Daymark.

steps.alt: Shelf with sample notes and images, search, filters, and tags.
steps.title: Filter by kind or tag.
steps.body: Pin what should stay on top, and tag entries so they are easy to gather again.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Shelf

steps.alt: Open sample note with its text, tags, and entry actions.
steps.title: A note, ready to return to.
steps.body: Copy it, share it, edit it, or move it to Recently deleted. Entries can be restored there for 30 days.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Shelf entry

steps.alt: Search sheet for finding tasks, notes, events, rituals, and weekly reviews.
steps.title: Find anything in the daybook.
steps.body: Search tasks, events, Shelf entries, rituals, and weekly reviews. Spotlight indexing is optional.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Search

chapters.title: Ask about your day.
chapters.intro: Ask Daymark answers from your daybook and makes typed, explainable changes. It works offline, with or without the optional model.

steps.alt: Ask Daymark in Daybook mode answering Brief me with sample events, tasks, and rituals.
steps.title: A brief from the day you have.
steps.body: Ask for the day’s shape and get an answer from the events, tasks, rituals, focus, and weather already in Daymark.
steps.label: Sample day
steps.caption: Ask Daymark

steps.alt: Ask Daymark on a physical iPhone turning a request to remember to water plants into a typed task action receipt.
steps.title: From phrase to typed action.
steps.body: With the optional Gemma 4 model, a loose sentence can produce a typed action and reviewable receipt. Daymark validates and writes the change.
steps.label: Example content
steps.caption: Gemma 4 Fast · iPhone

steps.alt: Ask Daymark on a physical iPhone answering what to do first from an explicitly selected sample daybook.
steps.title: Grounded by default.
steps.body: In Daybook mode, answers come from your actual day, and each reply is tagged with the mode that wrote it.
steps.label: Example content
steps.caption: Gemma 4 Fast · iPhone

steps.alt: Ask Daymark in Open chat mode with sample suggestions, a Web control, and the Fast on-device model selected.
steps.title: Open conversation, on request.
steps.body: Switch to Open chat for general questions. Web search is off unless you turn it on.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Open chat

chapters.title: Yours to set.
chapters.intro: Daymark starts empty and stays quiet until you ask for more.

steps.alt: Welcome screen with Enter Daymark and Explore a sample day.
steps.title: It starts empty.
steps.body: A fresh install holds nothing of yours. Explore a sample day to see the loop, then choose Start fresh to clear it.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Welcome

steps.alt: Appearance settings with System, Daylight, and fixed paper tones.
steps.title: Choose the paper.
steps.body: Pick a paper tone and an accent, or let Daylight move the page with the sun.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Appearance

steps.alt: Notification settings for morning brief, task due, ritual nudge, and event alerts.
steps.title: Reminders you opt into.
steps.body: A morning brief, due tasks, ritual nudges, and event alerts. Each one is off until you turn it on.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Notifications

steps.alt: Calendar and Reminders settings with calendar access off and a connect action.
steps.title: Your calendar, live.
steps.body: Connect Apple Calendar and Reminders, then choose the calendars and lists Daymark reads. Edits save back to those accounts.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Calendar & Reminders

steps.alt: Data settings with Spotlight, import, export, and erase controls.
steps.title: Keep a copy, or start again.
steps.body: Import or export tasks, events, and Shelf entries. Spotlight is optional. Erase Daymark data has its own confirmation.
steps.label: Product UI
steps.caption: Data
